_noteWUpgrade: W TRANSCENDENT TOGGLE (loop 479). The prior note called PassiveBonusDamage a genuine ~12% undercount that could not be curated because nothing carried the stack gate. The Upgraded condition is that missing piece. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Syndra, fetched 2026-08-21) walks the four thresholds: Q at 40 splinters gains a second charge, E at 80 widens the scatter and adds a slow, R at 100 gains a below-15%-health execute, and 120 grants a flat 15% AP. NONE of those adds damage to a hit. W at 60 is the only one that does: it adds 12% (+2% per 100 AP) bonus TRUE damage, which is exactly the BIN pair TOOLTIPONLYPassiveBonusPercent (0.12 + 0.0002 per AP) and PassiveBonusDamage (ThrowDamage multiplied by it). Curated as a second True hit gated on Upgraded, so an un-upgraded W is unchanged and the toggle adds the true-damage half. Everything else on this champion correctly stays as it was.
